source.working_tree: boozer_bc header parser accepts trailing text (this PR)

environment.host: office workstation CPU, shared (load 40-55, 62 GB with 2-3 GB free): two 4-core taskset workers, nice
environment.grid: 17 x 41 x 96 (Ntheta x Nzeta per period x Nxi), spectral angles, Nx = 1, tolerance 1e-8

reference.provenance: DKES, IPP, hydra_Np04_20190108; supplied by the repository owner as DKES_rho_<rho>.h5, not redistributable: only agreement statistics are stored

normalization.nu_prime: nuPrime = cmul |G + iota I| / (B0 nuD(x0)), nuD(1) = 0.836028 (DKX applies nuPrime B0 nuD / |G + iota I| = cmul)
normalization.e_star: EStar = efield |G| / (B0 |iota| r_hat), so v_E = |E_r|/(v B0) = efield
normalization.d_s: D_S are SFINCS transportMatrix entries; D* by dkes_transport_to_beidler (closed form of monoenergetic_dstar_from_transport_matrix)
normalization.d33: D33_S = -D33_dkes 2/(sqrt(pi) R0), R0 = |G|/B0: D33* = 1 at cmul = 10 to 1e-4

excluded.reason: the stored D11_S at efield = 0 is inconsistent with the .dk output of the same run, which DKX tracks at every radius to a constant factor; reported to the file's owner

convergence.note: each pair is [17x41x96, 25x61x160]: D11* moves at most 6% (cmul 1e-6, rho 0.12247) and <= 2% elsewhere, so the low-nu D11* gap at rho 0.12247 and efield 0.03 is not DKX resolution. A 33x81x256 rung was stopped unfinished.

exclusions: cmul below 1e-3 is reported, not gated: the DKES variational bounds are wide there and DKX's 17 x 41 x 96 grid is not converged (see convergence)
D31* at efield = 0 is not compared: DKES returns noise of either sign at its roundoff floor
rho = 0.5 at efield = 0 has no DKES reference in the supplied files
rho = 0.12247 is run at the first surface of the Boozer file plus 1e-7 in rN, because DKX interpolates between two surfaces
the DKES values cannot be redistributed: the record stores agreement statistics per regime, and the audit recomputes them only when DKX_DKES_HYDRA_DIR is set
DKES reports one value per point; no lower/upper variational bounds are in the files, so the comparison is against the single stored value
NTX is compared in its own repository (uwplasma/NTX#40), not in this record
